controls.reason: Switch actuation can be tested, but the complete tool path inventory and which deterministic functions are essential are not objectively bounded.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The documented switch disables registered tools, while a plugin still invokes an unregistered tool and a truly essential checkout function is lost.

controls.reason: Repository history is checkable, but the complete inventory of all nine artifact classes and validity of human review are not established.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All tracked files require review, while a deployment prompt stored in an external console changes without version history.

controls.reason: The proposal assumes a complete inventory of every model, dataset, prompt, index, feature, policy, and evaluation suite without defining its authority.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Registered releases use digests, while an unregistered prompt loaded from configuration has only a mutable name.

controls.reason: Distinct identifiers and credentials are observable, but complete environment and data-flow separation across all six stages is not proven.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Each stage has a different account, but an experiment credential can still read production training data through a shared store.

controls.reason: Authentication and digest checks are bounded, but reproducibility and complete coverage of all associated artifacts require an undefined build oracle and inventory.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The model digest and signer verify, while an untracked tokenizer changes the output and the build cannot be reproduced.

controls.reason: A known mutation interface can deny writes, but complete replacement-path coverage and approval of an emergency process remain unbounded.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The registry UI blocks manual replacement, while an operator overwrites a mounted prompt file outside the audited emergency path.

controls.reason: A fixed fixture set cannot prove feature and preprocessing equivalence over the complete valid input domain.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Approved fixtures match, while a Unicode timestamp edge case transforms differently in training and serving.

controls.reason: Required fields can be validated, but a complete model inventory and meaningful ownership, evidence, and approval cannot be inferred from records.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Every registry row has all fields, while an unregistered shadow model serves users and an unauthorized person is listed as approver.

controls.reason: Package-field presence does not prove a complete release inventory or that calibration and compatibility metadata are correct for the deployed model.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The package contains six named files, but calibration.json belongs to an earlier model and a hidden adapter is missing.

controls.reason: A finite compatibility matrix cannot cover every version, interaction, consumer, and valid behavior in both directions.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Named component pairs pass, while an older client and new retrieval schema silently drop authorization metadata.

controls.reason: Gate names and types are record facts, but suitable metrics, thresholds, fairness choices, and approval authority require accountable judgment.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All ten dimensions have automated and human gates, but the safety threshold is meaningless and the approver lacks authority.

controls.reason: Rollback tests do not define exhaustive state combinations, compatibility oracles, failure points, or acceptable recovery behavior.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The standard rollback fixture passes, while cached embeddings from a partial rollout are incompatible and corrupt results.

controls.reason: A production admission gate is observable, but complete update-path coverage, safe bounds, and validity of review are not objectively established.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The official online-learning job requires promotion, while a feedback worker writes weights directly through an unregistered path.

controls.reason: Before-and-after samples cannot prove complete behavioral equivalence or define which output differences require adequate renewed validation.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Common cases show no change, while one hardware-specific quantization path changes refusal behavior for an unseen language.

controls.reason: Peak and abuse load, dependency coverage, workload distributions, and passing capacity thresholds are undefined.
controls.counterexample_analysis: All six services pass the chosen load test, while a longer tool-loop attack exhausts provider quota and queues.

controls.reason: Registered invariants and finite load tests cannot exhaust combinations or prove isolation, freshness, and user safety semantics.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Backpressure tests pass, while load shedding drops a tenant boundary update and serves another tenant's stale result.

controls.reason: Metric-series presence is queryable, but complete agent/input scope and thresholds that detect genuinely unexpected cost behavior are not bounded.
controls.counterexample_analysis: Five dashboards exist, while a child-agent route emits no task tag and its runaway compute is never detected.

controls.reason: Record references are checkable, but complete AI component coverage and adequate drift, recovery, and readiness evidence are not.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The registered model appears in every record, while its vendor retrieval service is absent from disaster recovery.

controls.reason: Indicator names can be counted, but whether they correctly measure all thirteen concepts for the intended system requires domain definitions and thresholds.
controls.counterexample_analysis: The catalog has one metric per label, but fairness is measured only as global accuracy and hides severe group harm.
